subject: export-seeds now rewrites seeds concurrently (062f643b)
body: FYI David: autoresearch/research/export_seeds.py export_design now runs each seed's rewrite + faithfulness check in a thread pool (same rows, same order, per-seed failures unchanged; tests/test_export_seeds_parallel.py). Cuts minutes off the loop -> export -> c2_e3b hand-off. Shout if this conflicts with anything you have in flight.
